A good Vietnamese dinner at Saigon
Mar 2019 • Couples
It was our last day at Saigon and so we thought we should end it with some authentic Vietnam cuisine. 
Our guide suggested this restaurant. 
It had a very ethnic look. We had to climb the stairs to reach the place for our dinner. 
The menu had been predecided and so we had no trouble trying to understand the names. 
The menu was
Seafood spring roll ,
Shrimp & chicken with lotus root salad ,
Braised chicken with lemongrass & chilli ,
Fried fish with Tu Xuyen sauce ,
Stir fried choco fruit with garlic ,
Egg & tomato hot broth ,
Steamed rice 
Fruit

The food was very spicy and tasty . We enjoyed our food here.

What fantastic food
Sep 2018 • Family
This Resturant is a little tied in the decor and fittings. It is also hidden out of the way and you may have to search a little to find it. When you do you should be delighted with the choices. The quality and presentation is excellent. The flavours and taste are even better. I had prawns in tempura batter with savoury sauce. Our other dish was beef with honey sauce. That was more than enough food for two people. The staff were fantastic our waitress was "Tram" she is just learning English but we had no trouble in ordering drinks and our meal. The service was top class. Worth the effort to find.

Very average Vietnamese food
Sep 2017 • Couples
My wife and I visited the Vie heritage Restaurant along the rest of our 36 people Webjet Tour group as part of our package. Unless you knew where you were going it would be difficult to find as its located in an alley way.

I noted that the menu we had was priced at 33 PAX which I assume is $33 US (or about $41.25 AUS), if so highly priced for ordinary food. There was about 9 courses which consisted of paw paw salad, fried spring rolls, fried pieces of fish heavily coated in garlic, sweet BBQ chicken, chicken soup which came out at about number 7, fried chicken which was dry and bland, and a warm bean salad. Dessert was fruit. Beer cost a minimum if 47,000 Dong and a soft drink was 33,000 dong.

Drink service was poor as I had to call over an attendant as they forget to get our order along with the rest of the table of 16.

Would I return here again? Not a chance.

Cheers.

Sep 2017
We went to the Vietheritage bei accident. At first the menu seemed rather expensive but we were happy when we saw that we could get summer rolls for 60k hence it was what we were looking for anyway.
We shared a big bottle of water, but we didn't get a menu for drinks.
The summer rolls were ok but a bit boring and the peanut sauce was a way too small portion and it was not seasoned very much.
We had a bit of a shock when we got the bill because they charged us 69k for 1,5L water!!
What was really bothering us was that two girls who worked there were giggling when looking at us. That made us really feel uncomfortable and I think it's super unprofessional!
Wouldn't recommend eating at that place.
